content.title: Position plus orientation
content.description: Use a quaternion helper to obtain yaw. Compare a turned robot with a translated robot: both have a pose, but their heading differs.
steps: Include <tf2/utils.h> and read msg->pose.pose.orientation.
Pass the quaternion to tf2::getYaw(q); the returned angle is in radians.
Report x, y and yaw with kinenest::report_pose. Compare with the world display while an angular-only Twist turns the robot.
hints: A quaternion stores x, y, z and w; q.z alone is not the yaw angle.
Use const double yaw = tf2::getYaw(q). The helper returns an angle, not a quaternion component.
Positive yaw turns counterclockwise in this world.

hints: Een quaternion bevat x, y, z en w; q.z alleen is niet de yaw-hoek.
